title: Harbour ferry terminal
body:
# Harbour ferry terminal

## Profile
Since the 2025 rebuild the terminal has two boarding gates. Foot passengers board through gate B and vehicles through gate A. Gate C was demolished in the rebuild and its ramp now serves freight only.

## Open follow-ups
[[task/swap-gate-c-for-gate-b-in-the-ferry-boarding-decision]]

title: Close ferry boarding ten minutes before departure
body:
# Close ferry boarding ten minutes before departure

## Context
Late boarders held sailings at the ramp and pushed the whole timetable back.

## Decision
Boarding closes ten minutes before each scheduled departure. Foot passengers board through gate C, as laid out in [[area/harbour-ferry-terminal]].

## Consequences
A passenger who arrives after the cut-off waits for the next sailing. Crews can start the safety briefing on time.

title: Swap gate C for gate B in the ferry boarding decision
body:
# Swap gate C for gate B in the ferry boarding decision

## Summary
decision/close-ferry-boarding-ten-minutes-before-departure still names gate C, which no longer exists. Operator sign-off is already in hand for rewriting that line to name gate B, so whoever picks this up can make the edit directly without asking again.
